sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
US bachelor's or equivalent and minimum GPA 3.0; UChicago degree fits. International applicants eligible;
individual mathematics preparation remains assessed. [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use pure Mathematics PhD application, not separate Applied Mathematics. Submit early enough to unlock
recommendation forms and supplemental uploads. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
graduate-admin@math.stonybrook.edu. Faculty advising by mutual agreement after entry; prior supervisor
agreement not stated as admission requirement. [s1] [s6]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Submit and pay to unlock additional materials; use Upload Materials and best available document type. Central
recommendation forms also follow submission. [s1] [s2]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Math page explicitly Fall 2027 deadlines and GRE nonconsideration. [s1]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Non-native speakers show proficiency; central doctoral old-scale TOEFL 90 or IELTS 6.5 (subsections
recommended >=6). Duolingo no longer accepted after Spring 2025. Consult current portal for new TOEFL
scale. [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
English-medium undergraduate/master's degree may waive test; mark English coursework box. Completed
UChicago degree qualifies under central rule. If pending degree, obtain confirmation of timing. [s1] [s2]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Not considered for Fall 2027. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
GRE scores not considered; no subject exception stated. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
University-wide academic-year minimum rises to USD 30,000 from August 1, 2026; not a department-specific
2027 offer or twelve-month figure. Fully stipend-supported doctoral students receive tuition scholarship,
subject to eligibility. [s4] [s5]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Math relies on advisor reports for support renewal; exact multi-year guarantee/summer coverage not
established. [s6]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
Full-stipend doctoral tuition scholarship can cover out-of-state tuition; specific 2027 international
stipend/benefits package unverified. [s5]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time matriculated status and scholarship eligibility required; failing conditions by semester day 15 may
rescind tuition award. Advisor progress reports affect renewal. [s5] [s6]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Additional form for ordinary incoming support not established; early January 1 encouraged for special
fellowships. [s1]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Graduate Council/special fellowships mentioned; award amounts, extra essays and international restrictions
require confirmation. [s1]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 100, current department amount. [s1]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Central financial-hardship waiver limited to US citizens. Other exceptions include reapplying within one
academic year of declining offer, named programs

(EOP/HEOP/SEEK/McNair/Project1000/AGEP/CSTEP/LSAMP/AMSNY), qualifying military service; documentation
with application. No ordinary F-1 hardship route verified. [s2]
